english.title: Solemnize a marriage before the expiry of the waiting period in relation to the notice of marriage
english.standardoffencewording: On **(..SPECIFY DATE..) at **(..SPECIFY TOWNSHIP..) knowingly and wilfully solemnized a marriage between **(..SPECIFY PARTIES TO THE MARRIAGE..) on the authority of a marriage schedule at **(..SPECIFY LOCATION..) before **(..SPECIFY DATE OF EXPIRY..), the expiry of the waiting period in relation to the notice of marriage
english.legislation: Contrary to section 75(2)(d) of the Marriage Act 1949.
english.pointstoprove:
date and location
knowingly and wilfully
solemnized a marriage
on the authority of a marriage schedule
before the expiry of the waiting period
in relation to each notice of marriage

investigatoraction.description: DNA Samples: If crime scene stain present - take evidential sample If no crime scene stain and DNA not confirmed on PNC - take Criminal Justice sample. If DNA confirmed on PNC - CJ sample not required
Confirm proposed charge is appropriately authorised (Police or CPS)
Ensure compliance with investigator's obligations re disclosure
Consider if case suitable for referral to Financial Investigation Unit and CPS for asset recovery eg confiscation order

english.notes: The term 'marriage schedule' replaced the term 'certificates of a superintendent registrar' from the 4th May 2021 by the Marriage Regulations 2021 (SI 2021411)/. For offences which occur before this date, see H15902.
